I, Gayantha Karunatilake, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

An allotment of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No.GA/AMB/01/355 and dated 26.06.2001, prepared by the SurveyorGeneral, situated in the Village of Thalgasgoda (within the boundaryof Urban Council, Ambalangoda Thalgasgoda, Division No. 11) inthe Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ambalangoda in Galle Districtin Southern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot No. 17 – Thalgasgoda Bedda, No Assessment Number,Thalgasgoda Road – Extent: 1.093 HectareNorth: Lot No. 16 and Thalgasgoda Paddy field claimed byP. Maduwage and Others; East: Thalgasgoda Paddy field claimed byP. Maduwage and Others; South: Ambalangoda Batapola Main Road;West: Lot No. 16.
Gayantha Karunatilake,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
